title: The Dog Has to Be in the Van
lines: Mom tips pots and bags in a van.
The dog sits on its mat a lot.
"Do we have the dog?" said Mom.
Liz tugs at the dog. But it sits and sits.
"The dog has to have its mat," said Liz.
She fits its mat in the van.
The dog runs to its mat and wags.
"Look at the dog, Mom!" said Liz.
Mom zips the bags. The van runs.
scoring_note: Decodability forbids apostrophes, so this text is written in uncontracted forms. A child who reads "can't" for "can not", "don't" for "do not" or "let's" for "let us" is reading for meaning and MUST NOT be scored an error.
